description: This file defines the SageMakerRuntimeClient class used to interact with the Amazon SageMaker Runtime service, including methods for invoking endpoints and handling asynchronous operations.

classes.name: Aws\SageMakerRuntime\SageMakerRuntimeClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon SageMaker Runtime, providing methods to invoke endpoints synchronously and asynchronously.

methods.name: invokeEndpoint
methods.description: Invokes an Amazon SageMaker endpoint to perform inference synchronously.

methods.name: invokeEndpointAsync
methods.description: Invokes an Amazon SageMaker endpoint asynchronously, returning a Promise.

methods.name: invokeEndpointWithResponseStream
methods.description: Invokes an endpoint and streams the response.

methods.name: invokeEndpointWithResponseStreamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes an endpoint with streaming response.
